description: LM Local is a local AI chat assistant for Visual Studio 2022/2026 with agentic capabilities. It works with local engines (LM Studio, Ollama, Jan, Llama.cpp) and cloud providers (OpenAI-compatible APIs). You can ask it to edit code, run builds/tests, and apply changes.
